name: F-15E Strike Eagle / F-15EX Eagle II
summary: Two-seat, twin-engine dual-role strike fighter derived from the F-15 Eagle; the F-15EX Eagle II is the modernized fly-by-wire version replacing F-15Cs.

wings: Large high-mounted wing with about 45 degrees of leading-edge sweep and cropped tips
Underwing pylons often loaded with fuel tanks and missiles
engines: Two engines with round nozzles side by side
Rectangular box intakes on each side, with targeting and navigation pods often carried underneath
fuselage: Two-seat tandem cockpit under a long bubble canopy
Bulged conformal fuel tanks along the intake sides carrying rows of bombs on stub pylons
F-15E in dark gunship grey; F-15EX in lighter two-tone grey
tail: Horizontal stabilizers with a notched leading edge

tellTales: Two-seat canopy on a twin-tail heavy fighter
Bulged tanks along the fuselage sides with bombs mounted directly on them
Big box intakes with sensor pods hung underneath

confusedWith.howToTell: The Strike Eagle has two seats and conformal tanks, often in dark grey with bombs; the F-15C is usually a single-seater with smooth sides in light grey.
The Strike Eagle has upright fins, box intakes and round nozzles with external weapons; the F-22 has canted fins, flat nozzles and a clean stealth shape.

usCount.source: USAF F-15E/F-15EX fact sheets / FlightGlobal World Air Forces 2026
